question: Is there any floating-debris signal in Sentinel-2 under The Ocean Cleanup's 2021 measurements in the Great Pacific Garbage Patch?

sources.l1c_access: anonymous HTTPS GET/Range from this sandbox (200/206); the bucket is documented as requester-pays
sources.scl: sentinel-cogs L2A COG, windowed range reads

method.grid: the tile's 20 m grid; B08 and B04 reduced 10 m → 20 m (ACOLITE's resampling for ρ_s; 2×2 mean for TOA); B06, B11 native 20 m

corrections.acolite: PRIMARY. ACOLITE dark spectrum fitting on L1C: dsf_aot_estimate=fixed, resolved_geometry=False, ancillary_data=False, no glint correction, s2_target_res=20; ρ_s
corrections.toa: TOA, not atmospherically corrected: (DN + RADIO_ADD_OFFSET)/QUANTIFICATION_VALUE from the L1C product metadata

method.fdi: R8 − [R6 + (R11 − R6)·(λ8−λ4)/(λ11−λ4)·10]; 1.7722 S2A, 1.7770 S2B (asserted against the wavelengths)

masks.scl_water_cloud_buffer: SCL == 6 and > 300 m from any SCL 3/8/9/10 pixel

method.null: 200 random 2 km discs centred 12000–28000 m from the point, same scene, same mask, ≥ 5000 usable px; exceedance of the same background p99.9; target_rank = fraction of null discs below the target (ties half)
method.day_window: ±1 UTC day (acquisition UTC date − survey date as published)
method.selection: ≥ 5000 SCL-water px in the disc, ≥ 100000 background water px; ordered by |offset|, then disc water fraction; at most 30; one tile per (point, datatake) — the tile with the most water in disc and annulus
method.caveat_independence: pairs in one scene share its clouds, aerosol and noise; several survey points lie within a few km of each other, so their discs overlap — per-scene statistics are given
